'''Dioxo-brionchiectasis''' was a disease contracted on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[Rhinnal State Medical Academy]] released a report of middle-class districts on Coruscant that identified 10 species under the risk of being affected with diseases from the pollution, including [[Abinyshi]], [[Bovorian]], [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]], [[Mriss/Legends|Mriss]], [[Mrlssi]], [[Pa'lowick/Legends|Pa'lowick]], [[Quor'sav/Legends|Quor'sav]], [[Rishii/Legends|Rishii]], [[Shashay]], and [[Vor]]s.
